fields.Front: [Algorithms] What is the average-case time complexity of QuickSort?
[Algorithms] Under what pivot selection condition does QuickSort degrade to its worst-case time complexity $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$?
fields.Back: When the pivot consistently partitions the array into size $0$ and $n-1$ (e.g., choosing the first or last element on already sorted data).
